choose.otherwise: and (record.file_type is null or record.file_type = '' or record.file_type not in ('jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'bmp', 'webp', 'tif', 'tiff'))

mapper.select: select count(record.id) from fep_file_transfer_record record where record.task_id = #{taskId} and record.process_status in (2, 3)

select record.id, record.interface_id, collect.interface_name, record.file_name, record.file_type, record.file_length, record.object_name, record.completed_time from fep_file_transfer_record record left join collect_interface_config collect on collect.id = record.interface_id and collect.task_id = record.task_id where record.task_id = #{taskId} and record.process_status in (2, 3)
order by record.completed_time desc, record.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
